input.standard: ASTM E741 (tracer gas decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the volume of air served by /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1-v8, as V = Qe * tau from the CO2 decay at full speed after a reduced-speed phase.

steps.why: Reduced effective flow (0.3 m3/min, assuming linear in speed) so the Lab CO2 moves toward a higher equilibrium than at full speed; start from the measured 1900 ppm; duration capped by the 60 min ceiling.
Full speed (Qe = 1 m3/min), record the decay; about 1.3 tau for a first-guess V of 30 m3 (tau = 30 min); the first ~10 min (3 x scrubber lag 3.33 min) are excluded from the fit.

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
FE-1 out of the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring lost, or one more person in the Lab

monitoring.reason: FE-1 is the only occupant of the Lab, the volume whose CO2 the test changes.

hypotheses: The hatch /habitat/lab/hatch-1-v8 to hab-b is held closed throughout; the exchange through the closed hatch (design 3 m3/min per station-topology, larger than the scrubber's Qe) is NOT measured and is a hypothesis; hab-b CO2 (co2-2-v8) is recorded to show whether it exchanges air.
The Lab is one well-mixed zone and FE-1 (awake, 0.38 L/min, 0.26 to 0.45) keeps the same activity and stays in the Lab all through.
Effective flow scales linearly with speed: Qe = 1 m3/min at 100 percent, 0.3 at 30 percent (datasheet), scrubber lag 3.33 min.

With one occupant the equilibrium at 30 percent is G/Qe = 0.38 L/min / 0.3 m3/min = about 1270 ppm above the scrubbed air, below the starting 1900 ppm: a rise is only expected if the hatch exchange or the actual source is larger; the decay at full speed is fitted toward its own equilibrium anyway.
First guess V = 30 m3 (library default, range 10 to 200), stated as a guess only for sizing durations; the reduced phase is shorter than one time constant because of the 60 min ceiling.

expected.step1: CO2 at 30 percent stays between about 1700 and 2300 ppm and never reaches 3000 ppm; a drift toward a higher equilibrium is seen only if the hatch/source hypotheses hold.
expected.step2: CO2 decays exponentially toward C_eq (about 380 ppm above scrubbed air for one occupant if the hatch is tight); fit C(t) = C_eq + (C_0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau) after the first 10 min; tau about 30 min if V is 30 m3.
expected.result: V_lab = Qe * tau = 1 m3/min * tau; expected 30 m3 (plausible range 10 to 200).
expected.falsified_if: the decay is not single-exponential, hab-b CO2 follows the Lab's closely (hatch exchanges air, the one-zone hypothesis fails), C_eq is far from G/Qe, a person enters or leaves, or the scrubber refuses a command.
